description.value: POW Pizza serves Detroit-style pizza in Windermere, BC, with a sourdough crust naturally leavened with local spring water and baked in square steel pans with a signature cheese crown. The restaurant operates year-round and offers dine-out seating on an outdoor deck by the fire, a short walk from the lake. Notably, the business accepts cash and cryptocurrency only — no credit or debit cards.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates OSM tags well: the address, domain, and business name all match. The website explicitly states 'Take-Out or Dine-Out' confirming takeout; the menu includes a vegetarian pizza ('Tree Hugger') but no GF or vegan claim; no bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. The OSM phone number does not appear in the scraped website text, so it cannot be independently confirmed from the website.
concerns: Cash and Crypto only — no credit or debit card payments accepted. Cyclists without cash may be unable to purchase. OSM tags confirm Bitcoin/Lightning payment (currency:XBT=yes, payment:lightning=yes).
Phone number from OSM (+1-250-409-7691) not explicitly visible in scraped website text — could not independently confirm.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round restaurant with confirmed website and address. Useful stop for touring cyclists in the Windermere area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes 'Tree Hugger' (Bell Pepper, Mushroom, Onion, Zucchini, Brick Cheese, Tomato Sauce) — vegetarian. No vegan or gluten-free options mentioned
